rules:
AUTHORITATIVE USER RESET 19 SEPTEMBER 2026: Follow config/content_strategy.json and the newest master Notion page 3e0f2345-b318-81c0-9e1c-e8b4b7d19e9d. Exactly four logical posts DAILY per platform: one complete 12-sign carousel, one coherent five-card emotional story, one unusual real-phenomenon video and one different folklore/legend video. BOTH carousels occur every day. NO alternating dates, six-sign groups, separate card posts, dog/barista/terrier videos, avatars, weekly introductions or filler. All older 12/10, 13/19, dog-only, special 19 September bursts and dog-preservation exceptions are retired, including their retry and recovery instructions. Cancelled legacy work is not missing work.
PUBLISHING SAFETY: Approval Gate is the sole regular scheduler. Visual Story Assembly is the sole paid feature renderer. Do not schedule while migration is IN_PROGRESS or obsolete active queue entries remain. Fetch live Metricool queue, publication history and durable ledger before every write. Enforce one key local_date+category+platform plus a cross-date content fingerprint. Claim ownership before create, reconcile ambiguous results and NEVER repeat create blindly. Update existing eligible UUIDs instead of creating duplicates; use the returned new numeric ID and stable UUID. Preserve full original relevant payload, media and successful providers; omit unrelated networkData. Verify every write by reading. PENDING/SCHEDULED is not PUBLISHED. Published requires provider evidence and a returned public URL. A partial failure must not republish successful networks.
NO LEGACY RETRIES: Do not revive any cancelled old posts, dog drafts or Flying Dutchman versions. Both 19 September Dutchman publications already happened; their published copies have not been deleted. Future Dutchman UUID -8042687935771622605 remains retired. For a genuinely new non-retired item with a transient failure, at most one delayed retry on only the failed network is allowed after proving the original did not publish and checking current capacity. Unknown results, quota errors and format errors are not permission for automatic blind retry. Never rerender paid media for a publishing failure.
CAPACITY: Respect current provider/account limits, rolling 24-hour attempts including failed attempts, the previous day and next-day commitments. Midnight is not a presumed reset. No burst catch-up. A historical cooldown does not prove current availability; refresh actual errors before scheduling. On explicit account/quota failure stop new submissions to the affected scope and preserve ready media. Do not infer current plan from an old email or buy credits/upgrades. Continue eligible unaffected networks only when their independent checks pass.
EXISTING PHENOMENA: Preserve the one existing 18:00 Europe/Athens phenomenon entry for each date 20-30 September; reuse its media and UUID, never regenerate or duplicate it. New zodiac carousel, coherent story and a DIFFERENT legend still require actual media and QA before scheduling. From 1 October, prepare a new original phenomenon daily. Preferred implementation slots are 12:30,15:20,18:00,21:40, subject to capacity; these reuse prior slots and are not a new user-selected timetable.
FORMAT AND QA: Verify native API support for the requested complete 12-card and five-card carousels per connection. If unsupported, mark only that destination blocked; never omit cards, split into extra posts or silently change format. YouTube requires one actual complete readable slideshow video containing all cards. Cards have no narration/TTS/avatar. Narrated videos use Greek voice, full synchronized burned-in subtitles, lawful relevant images and clear fact/folklore distinction. Exact closing: Αν σας άρεσε, ακολουθήστε για περισσότερα. Use approved original/no-cost rights-cleared music only where supported. Verify real final media, duration, decode, audio, card order, readability, subtitles, sources and rights; a metadata label is not QA. No paid card generation, no duplicate render, no purchases, upgrades or access changes. Check current balance and reserved jobs before any authorized charged work.
REPORTING: Distinguish planned, preparing, blocked, scheduled and published. Draft=true cancels publication but is not permanent deletion of a hosted file. AutoPublish=false alone changes delivery to mobile notification and is NOT cancellation. Report only verified results; never claim the user reviewed unseen media or all four posts are ready when only one category is scheduled.

strong_people_tiktok_photo.note: Historical reference only; latest user reset prohibits reactivation, replacement and catch-up. This local retirement is not a claim of a newly verified remote deletion.

tiktok.exact_error: Auto publish failed. This TikTok creator has made too many posts via OpenAPI in the last 24 hours, so this publishing attempt is blocked to minimize spam. The user can try again later or publish it in the mobile app instead. (403)
tiktok.policy: Historical observation retained. Refresh actual account errors and rolling attempts before any write. Do not assume the old timestamp proves current availability. Defer blocked networks only; no burst retries.

observed_external_failures.error: The content format of the Tiktok photo is incorrect. The 'image/png' type is not allowed, use 'image/jpeg' or 'image/webp' instead.
observed_external_failures.note: Historical error, not a new failure. Never reactivate or replace this retired retry.

strategy_transition.rule: Prepare only the four approved daily categories. All dog and standalone-card campaigns are retired. No new carousel or legend is marked ready by this configuration change.
strategy_transition.existing_photo_posts_policy: Legacy standalone posts are retired drafts, not publication gaps. Only complete new carousels may enter the new program after QA.
